Indikator BHS: Deponija Uborak ne smrdi kada se prođe autobusom pored
Indicator English: The Uborak landfill does not stink when you pass by in bus.

Indikator BHS: Komunalne službe sakupljaju smeće u Potocima, ne ostavljaju ga ispred kuća petkom.
Indicator English: Utilities/communal services collect garbage in Potoci, and they do not leave it in front of houses on Fridays.

Indikator BHS: Komunalna služba pokupi sav otpad iz Potoka.
Indicator English: The utility service/communal service collects all the waste from Potoci.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima, kada ne znaš gdje ćeš, odeš u park i sretneš nekoga jer postoji park.
Indicator English: In Potoci, when you don't know where to go, you go to the park and run into someone because the park is there.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima ne uništavaju parkove.
Indicator English: People in Potoci do not destroy parks.

Indikator BHS: Parkovi u Potocima su lijepo uređeni sa cvijećem.
Indicator English: The parks in Potoci are beautifully decorated with flowers.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima su postavljeni ležeći policajci na putu za Rujište.
Indicator English: Speed bumps were placed in Potoci on the way to Rujište.

Indikator BHS: Postoji rasvjeta na putu prema Livču.
Indicator English: There are street lights on the road to Livač.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima se mijenjaju sijalice na uličnim svjetiljkama, tako da ima rasvjete.
Indicator English: In Potoci, the light bulbs on the street lamps are being changed, so there is street lighting.

Indikator BHS: Radni vijek nije produžen preko 65 godina starosti tako da se i mlađi mogu zaposliti
Indicator English: The retirement age has not been extended beyond 65 years of age, so younger people can also be employed.

Indikator BHS: Mjesna zajednica Potoci organizuje druženja mještana.
Indicator English: The local MZ of Potoci organises social gatherings.

Indikator BHS: Prekršaji u prometu se kažnjavaju.
Indicator English: Traffic violations are penalised.

Indikator BHS: Političari pokazuju primjerom da rade u interesu ljudi.
Indicator English: Politicians show, by example, that they are working in the interest of the people.

Indikator BHS: Političari pokazuju primjerom da rade u interesu zajedničkog života.
Indicator English: Politicians show by example that they work in the interest of life together.

Indikator BHS: Kada mladi iz Potoka žele da organizuju nešto ozbiljnije, institucije od kojih moraju tražiti pomoć ne komplikuju stvari jer se politika ne miješa.
Indicator English: When young people from Potoci want to organise something more serious, the institutions where they have to ask for help, do not complicate things because politics does not interfere.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima mogu živjeti od zemlje tako što prodaju poljoprivredne proizvode (npr. voće i povrće).
Indicator English: People in Potoci can live by selling agricultural products (e.g. fruits and vegetables).

Indikator BHS: Bošnjaci nemaju koristi ako se 100.000 Hrvata iseli za Njemačku.
Indicator English: Bosniaks do not benefit if 100,000 Croats emigrate to Germany.

Indikator BHS: U prodavnicama ima proizvoda iz BiH.
Indicator English: There are products from B&H in stores.

Indikator BHS: U firmama u Mostaru zajedno rade i Bošnjaci i Hrvati.
Indicator English: Bosniaks and Croats work together in companies in Mostar.

Indikator BHS: Kolege različitih nacionalnosti koje rade u istoj školi međusobno se časte za Božić i Bajram.
Indicator English: Colleagues of different nationalities who work in the same school treat each other for Christmas and Eid.

Indikator BHS: Bošnjak ima dosta kolega na fakultetu koji su druge vjere.
Indicator English: A Bosniak has many colleagues at the university who are of other faiths.

Indikator BHS: Više neformalnog obrazovanja poboljšava kvalitetu života.
Indicator English: More non-formal education improves the quality of life.

Indikator BHS: Mačkare/karneval se održava u Potocima.
Indicator English: Masquerade/carnival is held in Potoci.

Indikator BHS: U centru "Emaus", pored crkve u Potocima, održavaju se seminari.
Indicator English: Seminars are held at the Emmaus Center, next to the church in Potoci.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima postoji diskoteka u kojoj se svi druže navečer.
Indicator English: In Potoci there is a disco where everyone hangs out in the evening.

Indikator BHS: Postojeći Centar za kulturu, pored prostora, nudi bogat program radionica za djecu i mlade.
Indicator English: The existing Cultural Center, in addition to space, offers a rich program of workshops for children and youth.

Indikator BHS: Na Uborku se ne odlažu mrtve životinje.
Indicator English: Dead animals are not disposed of at Uborak.

Indikator BHS: Zastave Armije BiH i Šahovnica ne pokazuju da je Mostar podijeljen grad.
Indicator English: The flags of the Army of B&H and the Chequered flag do not show that Mostar is a divided city.

Indikator BHS: Osoba koja baci smeće na ulici se kažnjava.
Indicator English: A person who throws garbage on the street is punished.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi se ne pitaju svakodnevno hoće li biti rata.
Indicator English: People don't ask themselves every day if there will be a war.

Indikator BHS: Nacionalnost ne utiče na to da li će neko biti prijatelj ili ne.
Indicator English: Nationality does not affect whether someone will be friends or not.

Indikator BHS: Nikome nije u interesu da u BiH opet bude rat.
Indicator English: It's in no one's interest for there to be another war in B&H.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima je pokrenut zajednički projekat edukativnih radionica koji okuplja žene sve tri nacije
Indicator English: A joint project of educational workshops has been launched in Potoci, bringing together women from all three nations.

Indikator BHS: U slastičarni u Potocima postoje i palačinke, kako bi se mladi mogli družiti jedući palačinke.
Indicator English: There are also pancakes served in the patisserie in Potoci, so that young people can socialize while eating pancakes.

Indikator BHS: I Srbi i Hrvati i Bošnjaci jednako vole svoje Potoke.
Indicator English: Serbs, Croats and Bosniaks all love Potoci equally as their own.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima opet imaju izvorsku vodu u kanalima za navodnjavanje
Indicator English: People in Potoci again have spring water in the irrigation canals

Indikator BHS: Cigare se ne prodaju osobama mlađim od 18 godina.
Indicator English: Cigarettes are not sold to persons under 18 years of age.

Indikator BHS: Bijelo Polje je „šareno“ – jedna kuća muslimanska, druga katolička, treća pravoslavna
Indicator English: Bijelo Polje is "colourful" – one Muslim house, another Catholic, the third Orthodox.

Indikator BHS: Postoje projekti NVO-a u Potocima gdje se ljudi svih nacija druže.
Indicator English: There are NGO projects in Potoci where people of all nations socialize.

Indikator BHS: Susjedi u Potocima sarađuju jedni s drugima da se poboljša stanje, jer nije dovoljno da samo vlada mir.
Indicator English: Neighbors in Potoci cooperate with each other to improve the situation, because it is not enough that peace reigns.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima sade poljoprivredne proizvode i na taj način žive od svoga rada.
Indicator English: People in Potoci plant agricultural products and in that way make a living from their work.

Indikator BHS: Radnice u kladionicama ne puštaju djecu da kockaju.
Indicator English: Workers in betting shops do not let children gamble.

Indikator BHS: Alkohol se ne prodaje osobama mlađim od 18 godina.
Indicator English: Alcohol is not sold to people under 18 years of age.

Indikator BHS: Kada su bili protesti na Uborku, niko nije pitao ko je ko.
Indicator English: When there were protests at Uborak, no one asked who was who.

Indikator BHS: Djeca se uče u školi da se ne razlikuju po vjeri.
Indicator English: Children are taught in school not to differ each other by their religion.

Indikator BHS: Autobusi za Mostar voze i kada nema škole.
Indicator English: Buses to Mostar run even when there is no school.

Indikator BHS: Mjesne zajednice ne dozvoljavaju da se kladionice otvaraju pored škola.
Indicator English: Local communities do not allow betting shops to open next to schools.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima bošnjačka, hrvatska i srpska djeca, idu zajedno u istu osnovnu školu.
Indicator English: In Potoci, Bosniak, Croat and Serb children go to the same primary school together.

Indikator BHS: Uvedeno je više autobuskih linija iz Potoka za Mostar.
Indicator English: More bus lines from Potoci to Mostar have been introduced.

Indikator BHS: Djeca u Potocima se igraju zajedno, bez obzira na nacionalnost
Indicator English: Children in Potoci play together, regardless of their nationality.

Indikator BHS: Uspostavljen je odbor mjesnih zajednica koji organizuje zajedničke aktivnosti (npr. kulturne, edukativne) za sve ljude.
Indicator English: A local community committee has been established which organizes joint activities (e.g. cultural, educational) for all people.

Indikator BHS: Na TV ne objavljuju svaku večer priče o ratu u BiH.
Indicator English: They do not publish stories about the war in BiH on TV every night.

Indikator BHS: Vozači u Potocima koriste žmigavce.
Indicator English: Drivers in Potoci use turn signals.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima mladi ljudi različitih nacionalnosti izlaze u iste kafiće.
Indicator English: In Potoci, young people of different nationalities go out to the same cafes.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi nisu prisiljeni navodnjavati bašte sa hlorisanom vodom iz slavine.
Indicator English: People are not forced to irrigate their gardens with chlorinated tap water.

Indikator BHS: Maloljetnici ne hodaju po klubovima poslije 22.00 sata.
Indicator English: Minors don't frequent clubs after 10PM.

Indikator BHS: Više ljudi ima posao.
Indicator English: More people have jobs.

Indikator BHS: U BiH je razvijen turizam zahvaljujući iskorištavanju postojećeg prirodnog bogatstva.
Indicator English: Tourism has developed in B&H thanks to the use of existing natural resources.

Indikator BHS: Otac se trudi da se mržnja prema drugim nacijama ne širi međi njegovom djecom.
Indicator English: The father makes an effort not to spread hatred towards other nations among his children.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji Red Army-a znaju šta im djeca rade.
Indicator English: The parents of Red Army members know what their children are doing.

Indikator BHS: Jednom mjesečno, organizuju se radionice za mlade u Potocima.
Indicator English: Once a month, workshops for young people are organized in Potoci.

Indikator BHS: Mostarski orkestar ne izvodi samo praznične koncerte, jer u Mostaru ima više prostora gdje mogu nastupiti za brojnu publiku.
Indicator English: The Mostar Orchestra does not only perform holiday concerts, because there are more places in Mostar where they can perform for a large audience.

Indikator BHS: Djevojka ima prijatelje i Bošnjake i Hrvate.
Indicator English: The girl has both Bosniak and Croat friends.

Indikator BHS: Mladi ljudi koji završe školu nisu prisiljeni odlaziti u inostranstvo (zbog posla).
Indicator English: Young people who finish school are not forced to go abroad (for work).

Indikator BHS: Ultrasi ne dolaze po noći u Potoke kako bi pisali slovo „U“ na fasadama u ulicama u kojoj su Hrvati manjina.
Indicator English: Ultras do not come to Potoci at night to write the letter "U" on the facades in the streets where Croats are a minority.

Indikator BHS: Studentice generacije ne moraju ići u Njemačku, zato jer mogu dobiti posao u Mostaru.
Indicator English: Female valedictorians do not have to go to Germany, because they can get a job in Mostar.

Indikator BHS: Mediji ne izvještavaju o tuči dvije starije žene blizu Mašinsko-saobraćajane škole kao o međunacionalnom incidentu nekih učenica te škole.
Indicator English: The media do not report on the fight between two elderly women near the Mechanical and Traffic School as an interethnic incident of some students of that school.

Indikator BHS: Ljude se ne ubija u pojam tako da im se svaki dan serviraju male doze negativnih vijesti.
Indicator English: People's spirits are not crushed by being serving small doses of negative news every day.

Indikator BHS: Djevojka se neće promijeniti za nekoga kome se ne sviđa kako se oblači.
Indicator English: A girl will not change for someone who does not like the way she dresses.

Indikator BHS: Djevojka koja živi na granici između Hrvata i Bošnjaka u Potocima, ne može osjetiti da su drugačiji.
Indicator English: A girl living on the border between Croats and Bosniaks in Potoci cannot feel that they are different.

Indikator BHS: Za razliku od starijih generacija koje su doživjele rat, mladi žive bez nacionalnih podjela jer nisu doživjeli rat.
Indicator English: Unlike the older generations who experienced the war, the young live without national divisions because they have not experienced the war.

Indikator BHS: Kad djevojka dođe iz škole umorna, majka joj daje bar sat vremena da se malo opusti i odmori.
Indicator English: When a girl comes home from school tired, her mother gives her at least an hour to rest and relax.

Indikator BHS: Kada su bili protesti na Uborku, svi su, bez obzira na vjeru i nacionalnost, izašli na ulice, kako bi branili svoje mjesto.
Indicator English: When there were protests at Uborak, everyone, regardless of religion or nationality, took to the streets to protect their place.

Indikator BHS: Kad se desi neki incident između ljudi različitih nacionalnosti u gradu, ljudi ne govore, “ono su njihovi, to su naši.”
Indicator English: When there is an incident between people of different nationalities in the city, people don't say, "these are theirs, and these are ours."

Indikator BHS: Kada se desi incident poput tuče huligana, za to se ne krivi jedna cijela nacija.
Indicator English: When an incident like a hooligan fight happens, one whole nation is not blamed for that.

Indikator BHS: Smrad s Uborka se ne širi do Potoka.
Indicator English: The stench from Uborak does not spread to Potoci.

Indikator BHS: Vlast nije korumpirana i zato ne nastaju sukobi na nacionalnoj osnovi.
Indicator English: The government is not corrupt and therefore conflicts do not arise on a national basis.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji svojoj djeci ne pune glavu nacionalističkim predrasudama.
Indicator English: Parents do not fill their children's heads with nationalist prejudices.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji ne moraju imati političke veze da bi se njihova djeca zaposlila u Mostaru.
Indicator English: Parents do not have to have political connections in order for their children to be employed in Mostar.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima nisu uznemireni zato što svaku večer na TV čuju priču o ratu.
Indicator English: People in Potoci are not disturbed because they hear the war propaganda on TV every night.

Indikator BHS: Mediji ne prihvataju da za novac propagiraju rat.
Indicator English: The media does not accept to propagate war for money.

Indikator BHS: Grafiti budu samo kratko u Potocima, jer ih ljudi prefarbaju.
Indicator English: Graffiti is in Potoci for a short time only, because people repaint it.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima su ljudi bliži jedni drugima, jer su manja zajednica od Mostara.
Indicator English: In Potoci, people are closer to each other because they are a smaller community than Mostar.

Indikator BHS: Svako u Potocima ima s kim izaći vani i družiti se.
Indicator English: Everyone in Potoci has someone to go out and socialize with.

Indikator BHS: Kada su bili protesti na Uborku, svi su, bez obzira na vjeru i nacionalnost, izašli na ulice da protestuju za čist zrak.
Indicator English: When there were protests in Uborak, everyone, regardless of religion and nationality, took to the streets to protest for clean air.

Indikator BHS: Grad Mostar je napravio projekat, koji u Potocima potiče zajednički rad sve tri nacije.
Indicator English: The city of Mostar has made a project, which encourages the joint work of all three nations in Potoci.

Indikator BHS: Hrvat iz Potoka ne može biti agresor u Potocima.
Indicator English: A Croat from Potoci cannot be an aggressor in Potoci.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi ukazuju političarima na svoje potrebe po pitanju zapošljavanja.
Indicator English: People point out their employment needs to politicians.

Indikator BHS: Malonogometni turnir „Omer Tipura“, koji se organizuje svako ljeto u Potocima, okuplja veliki broj timova iz Mostara i okoline.
Indicator English: The indoor football tournament "Omer Tipura", which is organized every summer in Potoci, gathers a large number of teams from Mostar and the surrounding area.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi prihvataju škole podijeljene po nacionalnosti, jer prihvataju kulturološke razlike između ljudi.
Indicator English: People accept schools divided by nationality because they accept cultural differences between people.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji zajedno organizuju vannastavne projkete (edukativne radionice) za izgradnju pozitivnih ličnosti mladih.
Indicator English: Parents together organize extracurricular projects (educational workshops) to build positive personalities/characters of young people.

Indikator BHS: Kada Hrvatica i njena porodica imaju blagdane, bošnjačke porodice uvijek zovu da im čestitaju.
Indicator English: When a Croat and her family have holidays, Bosniak families always call to wish them a happy holiday.

Indikator BHS: Mladi razumiju da su starijim generacijama ostale neke ratne traume.
Indicator English: Young people understand that the older generations are left with some war trauma.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi znaju mirno rješavati probleme, da ne dođe do podjela u trenutku kada se u gradu desi neki incident između ljudi različitih nacionalnosti.
Indicator English: People know how to solve problems peacefully, so that there is no division in the moment when there is an incident in the city between people of different nationalities.

Indikator BHS: Ako je neki Ante nekome razbio glavu, ne znači da bi to uradio i Ivan.
Indicator English: If some Ante broke someone's head, it doesn't mean that Ivan would do the same.

Indikator BHS: Žena iz Potoka nije izgubila nadu da se išta može promijeniti u vezi raspisivanja konkursa.
Indicator English: A woman from Potoci does not lose hope that something can change regarding the announcement of a [job] vacancy.

Indikator BHS: Djeca i u Potocima, kao i u Mostaru, imaju prijatelje druge vjere.
Indicator English: Children in Potoci, like as in Mostar, have friends of other faiths.

Indikator BHS: Zimski grad u Mostaru je za sve ljude.
Indicator English: Winterville in Mostar is for all people.

Indikator BHS: Vjera ne utiče na to da li će neko biti prijatelj ili ne.
Indicator English: Faith does not affect whether someone will be friends or not.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima su navikli da čuju ezan sa džamije i zvona sa katoličke i pravoslavne crkve.
Indicator English: People in Potoci are used to hearing the call to prayer from the mosque and the bells from the Catholic and Orthodox churches.

Indikator BHS: Grad Mostar je osigurao novu pumpu za navodnjavanje iz jezera.
Indicator English: The city of Mostar has provided a new irrigation pump for irrigation from the lake.

Indikator BHS: Policija je odgovorna za sprečavanje huliganizma u Mostaru.
Indicator English: Police are responsible for preventing hooliganism in Mostar.

Indikator BHS: U Mostaru više nema huliganizma, jer huligani dobijaju 10-15 godina zatvora kada nekoga napadnu.
Indicator English: There is no more hooliganism in Mostar, because hooligans get 10-15 years in prison when they attack someone.

Indikator BHS: U Mostaru se osjete pomaci, nakon što je izabran novi gradonačelnik.
Indicator English: You can feel progress in Mostar after the new mayor was elected.

Indikator BHS: Više mladih ljudi je zaposleno pa imaju više međunacionalnog kontakta.
Indicator English: More young people are employed so they have more interethnic contact.

Indikator BHS: Djeca se uče u školi da se ne razlikuju po imenima.
Indicator English: Children are taught in school not to differentiate amongst one another by their name.

Indikator BHS: U Mostaru postoje srednje škole koje nisu podijeljene po nacionalnosti.
Indicator English: There are high schools in Mostar that are not divided by nationality.

Indikator BHS: Djeca Hrvatice iz Potoka, koja su išla u Muzičku školu u Mostaru sa bošnjačkom djecom, su se nastavili družiti s njima i poslije škole.
Indicator English: The children of a Croat from Potoci, who went to the Music School in Mostar with Bosniak children, continued to hang out with them after school.

Indikator BHS: Nacionalne podjele se ne prenose sa starijih na mlade.
Indicator English: National divisions are not passed on from the elderly to the young.

Indikator BHS: Hrvatska djeca idu u školu u Potocima, jer u njoj ima i hrvatski program.
Indicator English: Croatian children go to school in Potoci, because there is also a Croatian curriculum there.

Indikator BHS: Žena Bošnjakinja iz Potoka odgaja svoju djecu da je najvažnije biti čovjek, pa tek onda Bošnjak.
Indicator English: A Bosniak woman from Potoci teaches her children that the most important thing is to first be a human, and only then a Bosniak.

Indikator BHS: Djeca u kritičnoj dobi imaju mogućnost da korisno provode svoje vrijeme, npr. kroz sport.
Indicator English: Children at a critical age have the possibility to spend their time usefully, for example through sports.

Indikator BHS: Bivši ratni zarobljenik iz Potoka na javnim tribinama širom BiH šalje poruke pomirenja.
Indicator English: A former prisoner of war from Potoci is sending messages of reconciliation in public tribunes across B&H.

Indikator BHS: Hrvati i Bošnjaci u Potocima ne žive podijeljeni po ulicama.
Indicator English: Croats and Bosniaks in Potoci do not live divided by streets.

Indikator BHS: Ni u Mostaru, ni u Potocima, ljudi se ne ističu kao da su oni neko i nešto.
Indicator English: Neither in Mostar or in Potoci do people portray themselves as if they are someone and something [special].

Indikator BHS: Mladi u Potocima se druže na košarkaškim terenima.
Indicator English: Young people in Potoci hang out on basketball courts.

Indikator BHS: Mladi u Potocima se druže na fudbalskim terenima.
Indicator English: Young people in Potoci hang out on football fields.

Indikator BHS: Mladić Bošnjak i dalje ima prijatelje pravoslavce s kojima je išao u Mašinsko-saobraćajnu školu.
Indicator English: A young Bosniak guy still has Orthodox friends with whom he went to the Mechanical and Traffic School.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi znaju mirno rješavati probleme, da ne dođe do podjela u trenutku kada se dignu nacionalne tenzije tokom utakmica 2 kluba u Mostaru.
Indicator English: People know how to solve problems peacefully, so that there is no division at the moment when national tensions rise during the matches of the 2 (football) clubs in Mostar.

Indikator BHS: Djeca Bošnjakinje iz Potoka se svakodnevno igraju sa komšijama Srbima
Indicator English: Bosniak children from Potoci play with their Serb neighbors every day.

Indikator BHS: U kafić "Pub" u Potocima dolaze ljudi svih nacionalnosti.
Indicator English: People of all nationalities come to the cafe "Pub" in Potoci.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji Bošnjakinje iz Potoka su povratnici u Višiće (općina Čapljina) i sasvim normalno se druže sa komšijama Hrvatima.
Indicator English: The parents of a Bosniak woman from Potoci are returnees to Višići (Čapljina municipality) and they hang out with their Croat neighbors in a completely normal manner.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Mostaru nisu zaostali i ne spominju svaki dan šta je bilo prije 35 godina.
Indicator English: People in Mostar are not stuck in the past and do not mention every day what happened 35 years ago [prewar].

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Mostaru nisu zaostali i ne spominju svaki dan rat.
Indicator English: People in Mostar are not stuck in the past, mentioning the war every day.

Indikator BHS: Hrvat u Potocima ne primjećuje probleme na nacionalnoj osnovi.
Indicator English: A Croat in Potoci does not notice any problems on a national basis.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima vlada tolerancija po pitanju miješanih brakova.
Indicator English: In Potoci, tolerance reigns in regards to mixed marriages.

Indikator BHS: Hrvatu iz Potoka priskoči u pomoć susjed Salko kad god je potrebno.
Indicator English: A Croat from Potoci comes to the aid of his neighbor Salko whenever necessary.

Indikator BHS: U Potocima nema međunacionalnih tuča na dnevnoj osnovi.
Indicator English: There are no interethnic fights in Potoci on a daily basis.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Potocima čuju obje strane (i bošnjačku i hrvatsku) priče o ratu.
Indicator English: People in Potoci hear both sides (Bosniak and Croat) of war stories.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi Srbi, Bošnjaci i Hrvati se lako slože oko asfaltiranja puta.
Indicator English: Serbs, Bosniaks and Croats easily agree on paving the road.

Indikator BHS: Nikome u Potocima ne smeta što su katoličke kuće prve do džamije
Indicator English: Nobody in Potoci cares that Catholic houses are the first ones next to the mosque.

Indicator English: Željezničko naselje (Neighborhood around the railway track) is a peaceful place.

Indicator English: Drivers don't park in front of the entrances of buildings.

Indikator BHS: Više se ne priča da su djeca zadojena mržnjom zbog nečega što se desilo prije nego što su njihovi roditelji bili rođeni.
Indicator English: It is no longer spoken about that children are infested with hatred because of something that happened before their parents were born.

Indikator BHS: Teta u vrtiću „Sportić“ blizu Merkatora ne kaže mami Bošnjakinji koja želi da upiše svoje dijete tu, da će njena curica morati bojiti Hrvatsku zastavu.
Indicator English: The worker at kindergarten "Sportić" near shopping mall Merkator doesn't say to a Bosniak mother, who wants to sign up their kid to go there, that her little girl will have to color in a Croatian flag.

Indikator BHS: U Mostaru nema sukoba na nacionalnoj osnovi.
Indicator English: In Mostar there are no conflicts based on nationality.

Indikator BHS: Postavljene su kamere u Zaliku koje osiguravaju da vozači poštuju propise.
Indicator English: Cameras were installed around Zalik which make sure that the drivers are following the rules.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi koji žive na Strelištu imaju kanalizaciju.
Indicator English: People who live at Strelište (Shooting range) have sewage.

Indikator BHS: Kontejneri u Gornjem Zaliku ne predstavljaju izvor zaraze.
Indicator English: The trash cans in Gornji Zalik (Upper Zalik) aren't a source of any infections.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi koji žive u Gornjem Zaliku su zadovoljni što se njihovo smeće odvozi 2 puta sedmično.
Indicator English: People who live in Gornji Zalik (Upper Zalik) are pleased that their trash is being picked up twice a week.

Indikator BHS: Čovjek nije poginuo u ruševini u Mostaru prije par dana, jer su ruševine uklonjene.
Indicator English: A man didn't die in the ruins of a building in Mostar a few days ago because the building ruins were removed

Indikator BHS: MZ Zalik organizuje redovne sastanke sa stanovništvom.
Indicator English: The MZ Zalik organizes regular meetings with the residents.

Indikator BHS: Gradska uprava realizuje prijedloge koje daju stanovnici MZ Zalik.
Indicator English: The City Administration implements the proposals given by the residents of the MZ Zalik.

Indicator English: The protege of the Home for Orphans can go for surgery on time, because the Center for Social Work issued him health insurance.

Indikator BHS: Ljudima koji nas vode je u interesu da se smiri politička situacija u Mostaru.
Indicator English: It is in the interest of the people leading us that the political situation in Mostar calms down.

Indikator BHS: Na Starom Veležovom nije ispisan grafit "Ti si prvak šugave države".
Indicator English: The graffiti "You are the champion of the miserable country" is not written at Stari Veležov.

Indikator BHS: U vrtiću ne postoji vršnjačko nasilje.
Indicator English: Peer violence does not exist in kindergarten.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Mostaru ne čitaju riječ “rat” svaki dan na društvenim mrežama.
Indicator English: People in Mostar do not read the word "war" every day on social media.

Indikator BHS: U Zaliku nema buke.
Indicator English: There is no loud noise in Zalik

Indikator BHS: Osjećamo da je cijeli grad naš, a ne do jedne tačke jeste, a od te tačke više nije.
Indicator English: We feel that the whole city is ours, not that from one point it is, but from that point on, it isn't.

Indikator BHS: Momak koji se zove Adi ne misli da je kul ako se potuče sa momkom jer se zove Marko.
Indicator English: A boy named Adi doesn't think he is cool if he gets into a fight with a boy named Marko.

Indikator BHS: Ni ja niti moje prijateljice nismo odgojene da razdvajamo ljude po nacionalnosti.
Indicator English: Neither I nor my friends were raised to separate people by nationality.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Zaliku imaju dobre odnose s komšijom.
Indicator English: People in Zalik have good relations with their neighbors.

Indikator BHS: Hitna može doći do bolesnika u Zaliku, jer mu komšija nije parkirao auto ispred ulaza u kuću.
Indicator English: The emergency ambulance can come to the patient in Zalik, because his neighbor didn't park his car in front of the entrance of his (the patient's) house.

Indikator BHS: Megamarket daje popust 10% penzionerima svakog 10. u mjesecu.
Indicator English: Megamarket gives a 10% discount to retirees on the 10th of every month.

Indikator BHS: Učenici Bošnjaci i Hrvati iz Mašinske škole ne čekaju jedni druge da se pobiju.
Indicator English: Bosniak and Croatian students, who go to the High School of Mechanical Engineering, don't wait for each other to fight.

Indikator BHS: Djetetu u prvom osnovne mama neće reći “Srbi su ovakvi, Hrvati su onakvi, ti biraj samo svoje.”
Indicator English: A mother won't tell her child in first grade, "Serbs are like this, Croatians are like this, you choose only 'your people.'"

Indikator BHS: Žena iz Zalika bez problema ide pješke u bolnicu na Bijeli brijeg.
Indicator English: A woman from Zalik goes, without problem, on foot to the hospital on Bijeli Brijeg.

Indikator BHS: MZ Zalik služi kao primjer drugima, jer u njoj nema međunacionalne netrpeljivosti.
Indicator English: The MZ Zalik serves as an example to others, because there is no interethnic intolerance in it.

Indikator BHS: Ljudima ne trebaju ribarske čizme da pređu preko magistrale u Zaliku kada pada kiša.
Indicator English: People don't need fisherman boots to cross the highway in Zalik when it rains.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji maloljetnih navijača, koji prave nerede, se sankcionišu.
Indicator English: Parents of underaged fans, who start riots, are sanctioned.

Indikator BHS: U Mostaru navijače jednog kluba ne napdaju navijači suprotnog kluba .
Indicator English: In Mostar, fans of one club are not attacked by fans of the opposite club.

Indikator BHS: Djevojka koja živi u Zaliku studira na zapadnoj strani grada.
Indicator English: A girl who lives in Zalik goes to school on the west side of the city.

Indikator BHS: Studenti sa istočne strane poznaju studente sa zapadne strane.
Indicator English: Students from the east side know students from the west side.

Indikator BHS: Zimski bazar se organizuje redovno, a ne samo kad se Mostar kandiduje za Prijestolnicu kulture.
Indicator English: The winter market is organized often, not just when Mostar is running for the Capital of Culture.

Indikator BHS: Vozači poštuju pješačke prelaze.
Indicator English: Drivers respect the pedestrian crossings.

Indikator BHS: U Zaliku nema svađa.
Indicator English: In Zalik there are no arguments

Indikator BHS: U Zaliku nema osoba koje su opasne po druge.
Indicator English: There are no people in Zalik who are dangerous to others.

Indikator BHS: Migranti ne provaljuju ljudima u stanove u Zaliku.
Indicator English: Immigrants don't break into flats in Zalik.

Indikator BHS: Žena se osjeća sigurno da šeta sama s djetetom po mraku, jer nema migranata u Zaliku.
Indicator English: A woman feels safe to walk alone with her child at night because there are no immigrants in Zalik.

Indikator BHS: Žene sa istočne strane su upoznale neke žene sa zapadne strane.
Indicator English: Women from the east side have met some women from the west side.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi koji žive na lijevoj strani idu na desnu i obratno.
Indicator English: People who live on the east side go to the west one and vice versa.

Indikator BHS: Razgovori stanovnika, kao ova fokus grupa, pomažu rješavanju problema u zajednici.
Indicator English: Conversations between citizens, like this focus group, help solve problems in the community.

Indikator BHS: Mali s Luke nije otpušten sa posla u hrvatskoj firmi jer je navijač Veleža.
Indicator English: A kid from Luka (neighborhood) wasn't fired from his job in a Croatian company because he is a fan of the football club Velež.

Indikator BHS: Huligani Zrinjskog ne prijete da će uništiti firmu, ako vlasnik Hrvat ne otpusti momka koji je navijač Veleža.
Indicator English: Zrinjski's hooligans are not threatening to destroy the company if the Croat owner doesn't fire the guy who is a Velež fan.

Indikator BHS: Policija ne dolazi do pekare Sunce zbog tuče između djece sa istočne i zapadne strane.
Indicator English: Police don't come to Bakery Sunce (Sun) because of the fights between kids from the east and west side.

Indikator BHS: Bošnjačko dijete koje ide u vrtiću „Sportić“ blizu Merkatora ne mora da tamo jede svinjetinu.
Indicator English: The Bosniak child who goes to the kindergarten "Sportić" near Merkator does not need to eat pork there.

Indikator BHS: Žena iz Zalika se osjeća isto i na lijevoj i na desnoj strani.
Indicator English: A woman from Zalik feels the same on the left side and the right side (of the city).

Indikator BHS: Žena iz Zalika ne dijeli Mostar na strane.
Indicator English: A woman from Zalik doesn't divide Mostar into sides.

Indikator BHS: Ne gledate zastave druge države u svojoj državi
Indicator English: You don't see flags of another country in your own country.

Indikator BHS: U Zaliku ima dovoljno ležećih policajaca.
Indicator English: In Zalik there are enough speed bumps.

Indikator BHS: Ispred ambulante u Zaliku ima dovoljno parking mjesta za sve pacijente.
Indicator English: In front of the infirmary in Zalik there are enough parking spots for all patients.

Indikator BHS: U kontejner u Gornjem Zaliku se tokom vjerskih praznika ne bacaju životinjske iznutrice.
Indicator English: During religious holidays, animal intestines aren't being thrown in the trash can in Gornji Zalik (Upper Zalik).

Indikator BHS: Centar za socijalni rad reaguje na vrijeme ako direktor OŠ Zalik prijavi da neka djece ne dolaze redovno u školu.
Indicator English: The Center for Social Work reacts on time if the director of the Zalik Elementary School reports that some children aren't coming to school on a regular basis.

Indikator BHS: Nadležne institucije sprečavaju navijačke nerede u Mostaru.
Indicator English: Authorities are preventing fan riots in Mostar.

Indikator BHS: Kada stanovnik Zalika nešto prijavi mjesnoj zajednici, komisija koja dođe da pregleda taj problem ne dođe samo jednom ili dvaput, a da ništa ne riješi za 2 godine.
Indicator English: When a resident of Zalik reports something to the MZ, the commission that comes to review the problem does not come only once or twice, without solving anything in 2 years.

Indikator BHS: U osnovnoj školi djeca se uče kulturi življenja.
Indicator English: In primary school, children learn Culture of living.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi ne ostavljaju pse u Sjevernom logoru kad djeci počene škola, jer se više ne mogu igrati s njima.
Indicator English: People don't leave dogs in Sjeverni Logor (University Campus) when their kids start school because they can no longer play with them.

Indikator BHS: Gradska uprava reaguje kad im građani prijave problem pasa lutalica.
Indicator English: The City Administration reacts when citizens report an issue with stray dogs to them.

Indikator BHS: Ne postoji MZ u Mostaru gdje se loše stvari dešavaju.
Indicator English: There isn't an MZ in Mostar where bad things happen.

Indikator BHS: Policija hapsi četiri žene iz Sarajeva poznate zbog džeparanja koje su došle u Mostar, a ne upozorava samo građane da se čuvaju,
Indicator English: Police arrest four women from Sarajevo known for pickpocketing who came to Mostar, and do not just warn citizens to beware.

Indikator BHS: Svi stanari čiste prostor oko svoje zgrade, a ne samo stanari iz 2 stana.
Indicator English: All tenants clean the space around their building, not just tenants from two flats.

Indikator BHS: Čovjek rado ističe da živi u Zaliku, jer tu ljudi imaju empatiju prema drugima.
Indicator English: The man gladly points out that he lives in Zalik, because their people have empathy for others.

Indikator BHS: Konobar iz jednog kafića u Zaliku je trčao da uhvati osobu koja je opljačkala susjedni objekat.
Indicator English: A waiter from one cafe in Zalik ran to catch the person who robbed a neighboring building.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi ne donose 5-6 velikih crnih kesa punih smeća pa se kontejneri u Zaliku ne zatrpavaju.
Indicator English: People don't bring 5-6 big trash bags filled with garbage, so the trash cans in Zalik aren't overfilled.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi ne bacaju namještaj pored kontejnera.
Indicator English: People don't throw furniture next to trash cans.

Indikator BHS: Navijači Zrinjskog ne naručuju namjerno hranu, tako da bi prebili dostavljača iz Korza koji je navijač Veleža.
Indicator English: Zrinjski's fans do not deliberately order food in order to beat up a delivery man from Korzo who is a Velež fan.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji uče djecu da je rat bio prije 30 godina, tako da oni nemaju mržnju prema drugim nacionalnostima.
Indicator English: Parents teach their kids that the war happened thirty years ago, therefore, they don't have hate towards other nationalities.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji uče djecu da ako je na primjer “Mate“ ubio nekog njegovog, “Ivo“ nije kriv za to.

Indikator BHS: Na zapadnoj strani nema djece koja ne znaju kako izgledaju ljudi sa istočne strane Mostara.
Indicator English: On the west side there are no kids who don't know how the east side of Mostar looks.

Indikator BHS: Komos kosi travu oko zgrada u Zaliku.
Indicator English: Komos" (public firm) mows the grass around the buldings in Zalik.

Indikator BHS: U Zaliku, pješaci imaju više prostora za šetanje.
Indicator English: In Zalik, pedestrians have more space to take a walk.

Indikator BHS: Ispred pekare u Zaliku postoji trotoar za pješake.
Indicator English: In front of the bakery in Zalik there is a sidewalk for pedestrians

Indikator BHS: Centar za socijalni rad ne govori samo: „Neće se to više ponoviti“, kad ih direktor OŠ Zalik obavijesti da neka djec ne dolaze redovno u školu.
Indicator English: The Center for Social Work does not just say: "It will not happen again", when the director of the Zalik Elementary School informs them that some children do not come to school regularly.

Indikator BHS: Porodica, koja dobija pomoć od Centra za socijalni rad, redovno šalje svoju djecu u školu.
Indicator English: A family, which gets help from the Center for Social Work, regularly sends their kids to school.

Indikator BHS: Ljiljani kod Gradske vijećnice nisu minirani, kako bi se skrenula pažnja s činjenice da je Čović promijenio tok Radobolje.
Indicator English: The lilies at City Hall were not mined, in order to divert attention from the fact that Čović changed the path of the river Radobolja.

Indikator BHS: Navijači s područja MZ Zalik se ponašaju u skladu sa sportskim normama.
Indicator English: Football fans from the MZ Zalik behave in accordance with sport norms.

Indikator BHS: Studenti se brzo prilagađavaju novim ljudima na univerzitetu.
Indicator English: Students quickly adapt to new people at the university.

Indikator BHS: Djeca u Mostaru nisu podijeljeni u školama.
Indicator English: Kids in Mostar aren't divided in schools.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji ne uče djecu navijačke pjesme Veleža i Zrinjskoga u trećem osnovne.
Indicator English: Parents don't teach their kids the fan songs of either (football clubs) Velež nor Zrinjski in the 3rd grade of middle school.

Indikator BHS: Nijedan medij ne objavljuje lažne vijesti kako bi potakli nacionalizam.
Indicator English: Not one form of media posts fake news in order to encourage nationalism

Indikator BHS: Navijačke grupe ne prelaze na drugu stranu grada radi tuče.
Indicator English: Football fans don't cross to the other side of the town because of fights.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi u Zaliku ne bacaju smeće oko zgrada.
Indicator English: People in Zalik don't throw trash around the buildings

Indikator BHS: Vozači ne voze namjerno brzo kroz lokve da poprskaju pješake.
Indicator English: Drivers don't drive fast through puddles on purpose just to splash pedestrians.

Indikator BHS: 25 godina nakon rata ljudi stalno ne pričaju o miru.
Indicator English: 25 years after the war people don't constantly talk about peace.

Indikator BHS: Policajci se ponašaju profesionalno.
Indicator English: Policemen act professionally.

Indikator BHS: U Zaliku nema pljački.
Indicator English: In Zalik there aren't robberies.

Indikator BHS: Majka s djecom ne pretrčava cestu kad je crveno svjetlo na semaforu.
Indicator English: A mother with children does not run across the road when the traffic light is red.

Indikator BHS: Djevojka koja se vraća iz grada navečer, osjeća se sigurno čim prođe nadvožnjak na ulazu u Zalik.
Indicator English: A girl who is coming back from the city at night feels safe as soon as she passes the overpass at the entrance of Zalik.

Indikator BHS: Ne osjećaju se tenzije kada se organizuje neki turnir na Španskom trgu.
Indicator English: When a football match is organized on the Španski trg (Spanish square), no tensions can be felt.

Indikator BHS: Žena koja ima dijete u drugom razredu, pusti dijete od 7 i po godina da ide samo u školu.
Indicator English: A woman whose has a child in the 2nd grade lets her seven and a half year old child go to school by himself.

Indikator BHS: Zalik je mjesto gdje možete ostaviti automobil otključan.
Indicator English: Zalik is a place where you can leave your car unlocked.

Indikator BHS: Ženi koja je prolazila pored Mašinske škole tokom bitke nije pala baklja na kosu.
Indicator English: A torch doesn't fall on a woman's head as she was walking past the High School of Mechanical Engineering during a fight.

Indikator BHS: Mama djevojke od 18 godina je sigurna pustiti svoje dijete da sama hoda po mraku, jer nema migranata u Zaliku.
Indicator English: The mother of an 18 year old girls feels safe to let her child walk alone in the dark, because there are no migrants in Zalik.

Indikator BHS: Žena koja prolazi pored migranta koji stoji ispred ulaska u Mostar, ne mora da zaključa vrata auta, jer oni ne napadaju auta kad nude vozačima maramice.
Indicator English: A woman who passes by migrants which are standing in front of the entrance to Mostar does not need to lock the doors of her car, because they don't attack cars when offering drivers tissues.

Indikator BHS: Ne osjeti se averzija prema ženama sa druge strane grada, kao ni prema muškarcima.
Indicator English: There is no aversion towards women on the other side of the city, nor to men.

Indikator BHS: Ako vam kažu da je vuk strašan, nećete mu prići; mladima niko ne govori da su drugi strašni.
Indicator English: If someone tells you a wolf is scary, you won't come close to it. No one tells the young people that other people are scary.

Indikator BHS: Čovjek iz Zalika se i danas pazi s bivšim komšijama Hrvatima.
Indicator English: A person from Zalik gets along with their ex neighbors who are Croats.

Indikator BHS: Komšije u Željezničkom naselju su divne.
Indicator English: Neighbors at the Željezničko naselje (Neighborhood around the railway track) are amazing.

Indikator BHS: U Zalik se svaki dan doseljavaju novi ljudi, ali oni ne narušavaju duh zajedništva.
Indicator English: New people who move to Zalik don't ruin the spirit of togetherness.

Indikator BHS: Ljudi čiste smeće oko svojih zgrada.
Indicator English: People clean the trash around their buildings.

Indikator BHS: Žena koja radi u hrvatskoj firmi, gdje je jedina muslimanka od 115 radnika, nikad nije imala problema za 4 godine.
Indicator English: A woman who works at a Croatian company , where she is the only Muslim among 115 worker, never had any issues for the 4 years she has worked there.

Indikator BHS: Kada je bio fudbalski turnir, navijači Veleža nisu uništili restoran u tržnom centru Merkator.
Indicator English: When there was a football match, fans of the football club Velež didn't destroy a restaurant in the shopping mall Merkator.

Indikator BHS: Ženi, koja u Zaliku živi godinu dana, je drago što je tu.
Indicator English: A woman who has been living in Zalik for a year is glad she lives there.

Indikator BHS: Djeca različitih nacionalnosti iz svih dijelova grada su sastavljena, da vide da ni po čemu nisu drugačiji.
Indicator English: Kids of different nationalities from different parts of the city got together to see that they aren't so different from each other.

Indikator BHS: Roditelj Hrvat govori svom djetetu: “Tomo, neko ko se zove Ahmed nema rogove.”
Indicator English: A Croatian parent tells his son: "Tomo, someone who is called Ahmed doesn't have horns".

Indikator BHS: Djeca Bošnjakinje iz Zalika druže se s djecom njene prijateljice koje živi na zapadnoj strani.
Indicator English: The kids of a Bosniak woman who lives in Zalik, hang out with the kids of her friend who lives on the west side.

Indikator BHS: Bošnjakinja koja radi u bolnici na Bijelom Brijegu 14 godina nije nikad imala ikakvih problema zbog svoje nacije.
Indicator English: A Bosniak woman, who has been working at the University Clinical Hospital of Mostar, has never had any issues because of her nationality.

Indikator BHS: Dječak koji ne zna ništa o fudbalu zanima dječake koji vole fudbal.
Indicator English: The boy who does not like football hangs out with the boys who do like football.

Indikator BHS: Bošnjaci, Srbi i Hrvati se uzajamno posjećuju za vrijeme vjerskih praznika.
Indicator English: Bosniaks, Serbs and Croats visit each other during religious holidays.

Indikator BHS: Bošnjaci, Srbi i Hrvati se uzajamno posjećuju i kad nisu vjerski praznici.
Indicator English: Bosniaks, Serbs and Croats visit each other because of other reasons, not just because of religious holidays.

Indikator BHS: Ni na Starom Veležovom ni u Donjoj Mahali nema grafita koji provociraju ljude na nacionalnoj osnovi.
Indicator English: At Stari Veležov (Old Velež neighbourhood) or at Donja Mahala (Lower Mahala) there is no graffiti that provokes people based on their nationality

Indikator BHS: Vodovod ne stavlja visoke betonske ploče na šahtove, pa ljudi ne padaju preko njih.
Indicator English: Water supply system doesn't put high concrete slabs on the manholes, so people do not fall over them.

Indikator BHS: Postoji znak zabrane parkiranja kod pekare.
Indicator English: There is a no parking sign near the bakery.

Indikator BHS: Iz kontejnera u Gornjem Zaliku po cesti ne curi voda iz smeća.
Indicator English: There is no liquid leaking from the trash cans onto the street at Gornji Zalik (Upper Zalik).

Indikator BHS: Ljudi ne očekuju da Komos čisti smeće koje oni bacaju oko zgrade.
Indicator English: People don't expect the Public firm "Komos" to clean the trash which they throw around the buildings.

Indikator BHS: Žena, čija je kuća iznad magistrale, je dala da se napravi potporni zid ispred njene kuće, tako da voda ne silazi u Donji Zalik.
Indicator English: The woman, whose house is above the highway, had a supporting wall made in front of her house, so that the water does not go down to Donji Zalik.

Indikator BHS: Stanari zgrade u Zaliku pišu dopis Gradskoj upravi i traže da se ispila bor, koji prijeti da će pasti na jedan od balkona u zgradi.
Indicator English: The tenants of the building in Zalik are writing a letter to the City Administration asking for a pine tree to be cut down, which could fall on one of the balconies in the building.

Indikator BHS: Fudbalski klubovi u gradu Mostaru ne označavaju "svoju" teritoriju grafitima.
Indicator English: Football clubs in Mostar don't mark "their" territory with graffiti.

Indikator BHS: Nema veze ako muško dijete ne voli fudbal.
Indicator English: It's not a problem if a male child doesn't like football.

Indikator BHS: Dječak nema problema, zato što pleše break dance.
Indicator English: A boy who is learning breakdancing has no problems with the others.

Indikator BHS: Mladići ne moraju prihvatiti navijačku kulturu da budu cool.
Indicator English: Young men don't have to be football fans to be cool.

Indikator BHS: Bošnjački i Hrvatski učenici uživaju u zajedničkim aktivnostima.
Indicator English: Bosniak and Croatian students enjoy doing activities together.

Indikator BHS: Roditelji pohađaju obuku o mirovnom obrazovanju, tako da mogu edukovati svoju djecu.
